# Sanitized protocol baseline corpus

This directory is the committed, offline corpus for account search, article synchronization, albums, metadata, comments, and replies.

Each case uses this shape:

```text
<domain>/<case>/
  case.json
  request.sanitized.json
  response.sanitized.json
  expected.normalized.json
```

`case.json` records provenance category, capture date, upstream operation, sanitization rules, and expected classification. Real cookies, tokens, account credentials, private identifiers, or article bodies must not be committed. Captured production data must be pseudonymized and pass `yarn test:baseline:redact` before review.

Coverage is tracked in `coverage.json`. Synthetic fixtures are acceptable when they preserve the upstream response shape and exercise the same normalization rules. The committed corpus is generated and verified by `test/baseline/capture-protocol.ts`; run `yarn test:baseline:protocol:capture` only when intentionally approving a baseline change.

Export cases store semantic and structural output contracts rather than opaque browser-generated bytes. This keeps the corpus deterministic across platforms while retaining the current Web field order, offline-resource policy, OpenXML package expectations, and local-Chromium PDF contract.
